title: Model keys answer
description: The body of the server's signed 200, application/json, to a model keys report: for each key of the run's key group, the newest state per limit window from every gateway, under the run's credential names. The gateway takes each entry whose observed_at is newer than the state it has of that key and window, and does not set a key whose entry has a cooldown_until in the future. A member Forager does not recognise is ignored.

version.description: The document format. The gateway reads version 1 alone.

keys.description: One entry per key of the key group and limit window, each pair once.
